newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists bid for 412 bln lire of Italy 10-y Btp.
newsitem.headline: Specialists bid for 412 bln lire of Italy 10-y Btp.

text.p: Specialist bond traders bid for 412 billion lire of 10-year fixed-rate bonds (BTP) against the Italian Treasury's offer of 200 billion lire of paper.
Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 2.957 trillion lire at the open auction for the February 1, 2007 paper, against 2.0 trillion lire worth of bonds on offer.
The auction price was set at 94.65 from 95.70 at the previous sale on April 15. Gross yield was 7.66 vs 7.50 percent.
